# Verify that c:// imports produce a cgo preamble in fyne codegen.
# The generated model.go must contain import "C" and a #include directive.

sngl compile --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=out main.sngl
exists out/model.go

# cgo preamble: include directive for the header
grep '#include' out/model.go

# cgo preamble: import "C" line
grep 'import "C"' out/model.go

-- lib/math.h --
int add(int a, int b);
int sub(int a, int b);

-- main.sngl --
import clib "c://lib/math.h"

component main {
  window #app {
    text "hello"
  }
}
